name: Beau's Bar
description: A cash-only live music bar in Greenlawn filled with Grateful Dead and concert memorabilia. Jam bands and tribute acts (Dead, Phish, Allman Brothers, Led Zeppelin and more) play many nights a week.

dancing.notes: Review summaries describe a friendly jam-band crowd with good music and dancing. The room is small, and some visitors say it gets packed when a popular band plays, so people dance wherever they find room near the band.

evidence.note: Review summary mentions a super friendly crowd with good music, dancing and great people, especially for jam band fans.
Review roundup says the limited space gets crowded when bands are playing.
Venue profile calls it a Grateful Dead bar with bands covering the Dead, Phish and the Allman Brothers, plus extra patio space.
